name: Jal Jeevan Mission
description: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal) aims to provide safe and adequate drinking water through individual Functional Household Tap Connections (FHTC) to every rural household in India.
descriptionHindi: देश के प्रत्येक ग्रामीण परिवार को व्यक्तिगत नल कनेक्शन के माध्यम से सुरक्षित और पर्याप्त पेयजल की नियमित आपूर्ति।
benefits: Provision of potable tap water supply of 55 liters per capita per day to every rural home, schools, anganwadis, and community health centers.
benefitsHindi: प्रत्येक ग्रामीण घर में 55 लीटर प्रति व्यक्ति प्रतिदिन के हिसाब से स्वच्छ पेयजल की नल से आपूर्ति।
eligibilityText: All rural households, village institutions, schools, and anganwadi centers across all states and union territories.
eligibilityTextHindi: देश के सभी ग्रामीण परिवार एवं गांव के सार्वजनिक संस्थान।
sourceName: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation
